summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands on embedded systems experience across STM32, NVIDIA Jetson, and Raspberry Pi platforms. Builds real time embedded software in C and C++ on FreeRTOS and Linux, from bare metal peripheral drivers to multi board sensor integration. Background includes custom circuit board schematic design in EAGLE, UART and I2C protocol implementation, and technical documentation for hardware and software systems.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI based real time chroma keying without a green screen; produced technical documentation and a full bill of materials (BOM).

Developed a wearable gesture recognition glove for hands free cursor control, integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and embedded software integration end to end.
Designed and fabricated custom single layer circuit board schematics in EAGLE for locomotive robots; wrote embedded software over UART and I2C for closed loop sensor feedback control.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS, a real time operating system, with mutexes for shared memory task coordination on STM32 firmware; integrated VL53L0X time of flight sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Used YOLOv8 on an NVIDIA Jetson (Linux) to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi servo PWM control with interrupt driven UART command handling and user override.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer synchronized sensing and real time display.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) with timer triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt driven sample capture, and a low level I2C driver.
Achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified circuit behavior in Proteus.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a three layer distributed pipeline (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson and Arduino controller) linking a Linux based edge server to embedded microcontroller firmware over a unified WebSocket interface.

Resolved 11 integration failures across the embedded and vision stack (false positive detections, servo brownout, stale frame capture) through systematic root cause analysis; achieved 100% pick reliability (10 of 10 trials).
Implemented two-link inverse kinematics on an Arduino microcontroller in C++, driving five servos with range gated contact detection via I2C connected time of flight sensors.
